races.paceDynamic: Twisting Physics is the clear pace-setter with no obvious rivals for the early lead, allowing Jamie Spencer to dictate a steady gallop without pressure. Indian Spirit, Jimmy Speaking and Canvas will sit prominent behind the leader, but none are aggressive enough to force the pace. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses (Sterling Knight, Helm Rock, Mr Baloo, Knights Gold, Where's Freddy, Final Night, Phone Tag), the race will develop into a sustained drive from the 3f pole as the back markers attempt to make ground. This controlled tempo strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks over pure front-runners who might tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Tempo Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Twisting Physics sets an honest but manageable gallop without pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The steady pace allows hold-up horses to close effectively in the straight. Proven finishers with good recent form can time their challenges to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine enough to blunt the finishing kicks of back markers
scenarios.body: Jimmy Speaking and Indian Spirit can travel smoothly behind Twisting Physics before striking in the final 2f. Their tactical positioning proves decisive against horses coming from too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Twisting Physics gets easy sectionals early and has enough left for the finish
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead allows the front-runner to maintain momentum when challenged. Hold-up horses find the pace has been too steady to generate a strong finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a pure speed test from 2f out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of position. Long-absent runners with residual ability could surprise.

watchPoints.text: Twisting Physics could get uncontested fractions that are too slow to set up a proper finish for the closers
Indian Spirit and Canvas both return from 200+ day layoffs which makes their fitness levels questionable
Jimmy Speaking has won his last two races and sits perfectly to track the likely leader Twisting Physics
Multiple horses carry headgear changes including Mr Baloo's first-time pacifier and Where's Freddy's tongue-tie
Final Night and Gorgeous Mr George both benefit from apprentice allowances that could prove significant in a tight finish

races.paceDynamic: Bobby Bennu leads with Son, I Still Have Faith, Goldmoyne, and Golden Redemption forming the prominent pack, creating a solid early gallop over 7f at Newmarket. The large field of hold-up horses (Forty Years On, Shah, Darkness, Silver Ghost, Angel Hunter, Arctic Dawn, Dark Tornado, Superposition) will be bunched behind this early pace. With multiple prominent runners ensuring no crawl and the straight course allowing patient tactics to work, this race strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish from off the pace. The sustained tempo will set up perfectly for closers with the class and finishing kick to strike late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Class Hold-Up Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack maintains honest fractions without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The sustained pace perfectly suits the classy closers who can unleash their finishing kick in the final 2f. Forty Years On and Dark Tornado benefit most from their patient tactics and superior class ratings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Group Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Bobby Bennu and the prominent pack can dictate slower fractions than expected
scenarios.body: The early leaders get first run and hold off the late challenge, with Son's recent form and Golden Redemption's consistency proving decisive. The hold-up horses find too much to do despite their class advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too fast early and come back to the field significantly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of early position. Silver Ghost's recent Newmarket form and Angel Hunter's finishing kick become crucial factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is perfectly judged but the favourites underperform or meet trouble
scenarios.body: A horse like I Still Have Faith or Goldmoyne, running their best race at the right time, capitalizes on the ideal setup. Their prominent position combines with unexpected improvement to spring a surprise.

watchPoints.text: Bobby Bennu must be monitored for early pace judgment as sole natural leader could dictate race tempo entirely
Watch Forty Years On and Dark Tornado settling positions as both need patient rides to maximize their finishing kicks
Son and Golden Redemption's early positioning crucial as prominent runners who need to avoid being caught wide
Shah and Arctic Dawn returning from long breaks must be watched for fitness levels despite tactical advantages
Monitor the pace through halfway splits as this will determine whether hold-up horses get their preferred strong gallop

races.paceDynamic: Sixtygeesbaby will set a comfortable pace from the front with limited early pressure, as most rivals prefer prominent or hold-up positions. Miraculous, Tabby, Dashing Dick and Pressure's On may track the leader but none are confirmed pace-pressers. The sustainable gallop will set up perfectly for hold-up horses like Expert Agent, State Of Madness, Arantes Nascimento and Izzy Fast to deliver late runs. This race shape strongly favours closers and hold-up horses who can pick off the prominent runners in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Sixtygeesbaby sets an honest but sustainable pace without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The comfortable gallop allows Expert Agent, State Of Madness and Arantes Nascimento to position perfectly and unleash telling late runs. Hold-up specialists benefit from the strong pace and spread-out field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Persist
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and the front runners maintain their kick
scenarios.body: Miraculous and Tabby can capitalise on their forward positions when the pace doesn't truly test stamina. Recent winner Tabby particularly suits this scenario given current form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Sixtygeesbaby gets an uncontested lead and finds another gear when challenged
scenarios.body: The lack of natural pace-pressers allows the leader to control proceedings completely and kick clear when it matters. Loughnane's 7lb claim becomes crucial in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or key fancied runners hit traffic problems
scenarios.body: Rajaking returning from 212-day break could benefit from a messy race where class tells over fitness. State Of Madness from a light weight also capable if others falter.

watchPoints.text: Sixtygeesbaby must be watched for how much early pressure he faces, as uncontested lead could prove decisive
Expert Agent needs clear running room in final furlong given hold-up style and Ghiani's tendency to get boxed in

State Of Madness requires strong pace to unleash finishing kick, vulnerable if gallop becomes too steady
Rajaking returning from 212 days off needs monitoring for any signs of ring-rustiness or market confidence

runners_data.name: Superior Choice

runners_data.name: Koala Rose

races.paceDynamic: Shabab Al Ahli will dictate terms from the front with Chasing Time likely to track in second, creating a manageable gallop in this small field. The lack of natural speed horses means the early pace will be steady rather than strong, allowing the race to develop into a sprint finish over the final 3-4 furlongs. With most runners carrying hold-up styles except the two Appleby horses, this sets up perfectly for closers to unleash late kicks. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing efforts from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers' Paradise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady as expected with Shabab Al Ahli unopposed early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a stamina test in the final quarter-mile where late-running horses can use their class advantage. Superior Choice and Turty Tree are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven closing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Shabab Al Ahli and Chasing Time kick clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get caught flat-footed by the change of pace and can't reel in the leaders. Shabab Al Ahli's class tells in a sustained drive to the line.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection
scenarios.trigger: If Billy Loughnane decides to inject pace on Shabab Al Ahli from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours horses with tactical speed over pure closers. Chasing Time benefits most from tracking the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If both prominent runners wait too long and create a crawling pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where draw and position matter more than class. Any horse can win in a blanket finish with minor placings up for grabs.

watchPoints.text: Superior Choice's withdrawal removes the highest-rated runner and opens up the race significantly for the remaining quintet
Shabab Al Ahli's stamina at 1m4f is unproven and he may weaken if the pace becomes too strong in the final stages
Koala Rose returns after 147 days off which could leave her short of peak fitness despite the significant weight advantage
Andrew Balding's 16/79 strike rate gives Turty Tree a live trainer angle in what looks a tactical contest
The small field of five could lead to a messy tactical battle if both prominent runners decide to wait

races.paceDynamic: Sharp Romance, Battosai, and Folk Pageant will all want to lead from the start, creating a fierce early battle for position with no natural early pace angles. This triumvirate will force a strong gallop that will stretch the field early, with the prominent runners Alpine Culture, Eddaari, Royal Poetry, and The Joker tracking just behind. The sustained pace over 1m2f will expose stamina limitations and set up a scenario where horses with tactical speed can capitalise. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can sit close without doing the donkey work, as they'll have first strike when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Burn Each Other
scenarios.trigger: If Sharp Romance, Battosai, and Folk Pageant engage in an early speed duel through the first half-mile.
scenarios.body: The pace will be unsustainable with all three trying to assert dominance, leaving them vulnerable to the prominent runners who can track and pounce. The tactical speed of the prominent group becomes decisive as the leaders pay for their early exertions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Sharp Romance or Battosai can steal a march and get first run while the other two are scrapping.
scenarios.body: The lone leader gets breathing space while the pace behind remains strong enough to stretch the field but not fast enough to reel in the escapee. Late closers struggle to make up the ground from the sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Hold-Up
scenarios.trigger: If the three-way speed battle creates an exceptionally strong gallop that completely breaks up the field.
scenarios.body: Guest House benefits from the extreme pace scenario despite stamina concerns, as the field comes back to him in the final furlong. The prominent runners get caught between the collapsing leaders and the closing hold-up horse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders check each other's pace early and settle into a tactical crawl.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the home turn, favouring horses with the best turn of foot regardless of stamina. This negates the distance and turns it into a speed test over the final three furlongs.

watchPoints.text: Sharp Romance and Battosai could both be sent forward aggressively early, creating an unsustainable pace that compromises both
Guest House needs to be produced with perfect timing as he has shown a tendency to fade in the final stages
Royal Poetry's last-start win came in testing conditions and he needs to confirm that form translates to good ground
Folk Pageant's 44-day absence could leave him vulnerable to sharper rivals in what promises to be a strongly-run race
The three prominent runners Alpine Culture, Eddaari, and The Joker will be closely bunched turning for home, creating traffic concerns

races.paceDynamic: Cherry Cobbler will lead from the gates with Dashing Donkey, Mickey Mongoose and Regal Guest likely to press early, creating a moderate gallop over this 7f trip. The pace should be honest but not punishing, as Cherry Cobbler has shown front-running tendencies and the prominent runners will apply enough pressure to ensure no soft lead. With five hold-up horses including Tex, Wrydcroft, Fancy Dancer and African Spirit needing to come from off the pace, the early leaders will face sustained pressure in the home straight. This race shape clearly favors prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, as they'll avoid traffic issues while the hold-up brigade may find limited room in a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Cherry Cobbler sets honest pace and prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: The pace-setters tire in final furlong as Mickey Mongoose and Dashing Donkey benefit from tracking positions. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in time over this sharp 7f trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If early pace becomes too strong between Cherry Cobbler and prominent pack
scenarios.body: The leaders come back to the closers as Tex and Wrydcroft benefit from their class advantage. Strong finishing kick overcomes the tactical disadvantage in this small field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Cherry Cobbler gets uncontested lead and prominent horses fail to press
scenarios.body: Cherry Cobbler maintains sustainable gallop and holds off late challenges. The 21-day break proves beneficial rather than detrimental to fitness levels.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If early pace becomes crawling affair with tactical maneuvering
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy sprint with positioning crucial over final 2f. Jockey tactics and late acceleration determine outcome rather than running styles.

watchPoints.text: African Spirit hasn't run for 476 days and showed fading tendencies before the break
Cherry Cobbler's trainer Stuart Williams has poor 0/21 recent record and horse shows declining form
Wrydcroft carries joint-top weight but has won three of last five starts including recent course success
Fancy Dancer returns from 149-day absence in first-time headgear for small stable
Mickey Mongoose gets significant 10lb weight advantage and wore successful blinkers last time
